content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"Insurance underwriter earning premiums and annuity spreads, not fees on managed investment assets."},{"label":"C2","good":false,"reason":"Insurance brokerage earning commissions from carriers; it does not manage investment portfolios."},{"label":"C3","good":true,"reason":"Investment manager selling funds and separate accounts to institutions and advisers, earning AUM fees, like the target."},{"label":"C4","good":true,"reason":"Boutique-style manager of mutual funds, ETFs and separate accounts sold via advisers, earning AUM fees."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Annuity and life insurer earning investment income on policyholder funds, not an asset manager selling funds."},{"label":"C6","good":true,"reason":"Manages mutual funds, closed-end funds and separate accounts sold through broker-dealers, earning AUM fees."},{"label":"C7","good":true,"reason":"Institutional asset manager selling funds and separate accounts for fees, though focused on alternative strategies."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"Health savings account custodian and benefits administrator earning account and transaction fees for employers."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Operates OTC trading venues and sells market data and disclosure services to companies, not asset management."},{"label":"C10","good":true,"reason":"Fee-based investment manager running separate accounts and pooled funds for affluent clients and institutions."},{"label":"C11","good":false,"reason":"Software vendor and outsourced back-office provider licensing technology, not a manager of investment assets."},{"label":"C12","good":false,"reason":"Insurance brokerage placing coverage with carriers for commissions; no investment fund management."}]}
